notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; business-type activities on the accrual basis (government-wide and proprietary statements). Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p5); fund-balance roll-forward 1,498,181 -> 1,746,360. Beginning governmental cash not printed, so beginning_cash null; ending_cash = Cash and cash equivalents 1,729,226 (p4; the government-wide statement splits it into 869,767 current + 859,459 restricted); County treasurer cash 13,042 is a separate line (not added); certificates of deposit 4,092 in ending_investments. Loan proceeds 134,669 are printed among revenues, so a receipt line (Loan Proceeds). 'Grants and contributions' 143,626 has no grantor printed (Statement of Activities shows it as capital grants and contributions for public works): donations/contributions (mixed grant/contribution label, as FY2025), with review. Business-type lines from the proprietary funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total column (p9), as in FY2023/FY2024: operating revenues 2,572,026 + nonoperating interest 11,860 and franchise fees 120,000 (receipts total = their sum, no single total printed), operating expenses by cost type 2,572,208 + interest expense 42,465 = 2,614,673 (= Statement of Activities business-type expenses p2), transfers from other funds 80,000, net position 5,989,145 -> 6,158,358. Utility 'Other revenue' 81,800 is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities (p2), so charges for services. Proprietary cash flows from the Total column (p11). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (totals equal the government-wide governmental column 1,746,360), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position business-type column; totals from the Total column. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (p15-16, more detailed), so the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p12) is not recorded; Street Fund budget schedule (p13); nonmajor funds by column (p14; Grant Fund has no activity); enterprise funds have no supplementary schedule, so no enterprise detail (as FY2023). Department 'Transportation' lines are a context label with no object printed: detail_category miscellaneous expenditure with review. Street Fund 'Intergovernmental' kept other state aid (highway allocation not printed). Read pages 1-16 of 16
